summary: Greedy decoding isolated on contrastive-RAG best base
hypothesis: Switching the single generation call from stochastic sampling to greedy (deterministic) decoding on the best contrastive-RAG base (exp011) should reduce noise and surface sharper, more specific unknowns — because every prior ~0.32 result was a noisy single draw, and a deterministic mode might consistently hit a better mode than sampling luck.
technique: The exp011 contrastive-RAG topology was held completely fixed; only the decoding of the single generation call was swapped to greedy (temperature 0, deterministic mode) to isolate the decoding lever on the best-performing base pipeline.
label: exp019
